note: Phase 3 candidate works for the 6 women with no book in books.json. Editorial preference: own work > memoirs/speeches > academic/recognised biography > historical study > none. Verified against Open Library.

title.pt: A Vida Quer é Coragem: A Trajetória de Dilma Rousseff, a Primeira Presidenta do Brasil
title.en: A Vida Quer é Coragem: A Trajetória de Dilma Rousseff

dilma-rousseff.author: Ricardo Batista Amaral
dilma-rousseff.rationale: Rousseff has published no memoir or authored work. Amaral's is the standard Brazilian biography, published by Primeira Pessoa/Sextante and widely distributed.

title.pt: To Love Another Day: As Memórias de Cory Aquino
title.en: To Love Another Day: The Memoirs of Cory Aquino

corazon-aquino.author: Corazon Aquino
corazon-aquino.rationale: Closest thing to her own voice: transcribed from private filmed interviews recorded to support the autobiography she left unfinished at her death in 2009. Published posthumously by her family.

michelle-bachelet.author: Lucía Dammert, Silvia Borzutzky
michelle-bachelet.rationale: Bachelet has published no memoir. This is the academic treatment of her two presidencies (human rights, social policy, democratic quality, inclusion of women), from a university press.

title.pt: The Rise and Fall of Nicolae and Elena Ceausescu
title.en: The Rise and Fall of Nicolae and Elena Ceausescu

elena-ceausescu.author: Mark Almond
elena-ceausescu.rationale: Her own 'scientific' publications in polymer chemistry are regarded as ghostwritten and fraudulent, so they are editorially inadequate as authored works. Almond's is a recognised historical biography covering her specifically, not only Nicolae. Alternative considered: Edward Behr, Kiss the Hand You Cannot Bite (1991, ISBN 9780679401285).

jiang-qing.author: Ross Terrill
jiang-qing.publisher: Bantam Books; revised edition Stanford University Press, 1999
jiang-qing.rationale: The standard scholarly biography, revised and reissued by Stanford University Press. Alternative considered: Roxane Witke, Comrade Chiang Ch'ing (1977, ISBN 9780316949002), built on sixty hours of interviews with Jiang Qing herself — closer to her own voice but long out of print.

kim-jong-suk.rationale: No editorially adequate work exists. The only book-length treatments are DPRK state hagiographies from the Foreign Languages Publishing House in Pyongyang (Kim Jong Suk, 2002; Kim Ok Sun, Kim Jong Suk, the Anti-Japanese Heroine, 1997), which carry no ISBN, no independent scholarship and no commercial distribution. Per the audit rule, this stays no-book rather than filling the slot.
